summary: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K on April 28, 2026, informing the SEC of a routine board resolution to replace one member of its Audit Committee. Ms. Adriana María Fernández de Melero was replaced by Mr. Lorenzo de Cristóbal de Nicolás, with the committee now composed of three directors and an internal audit director. No transaction, shareholder return, or special situation is involved; this is an ordinary governance update. The filing is a foreign private issuer report of a committee composition change, not equivalent to any US special-situation category.
